:8080 redirect, :8443 TLS
static SPA, CSP and security headers
/api/ proxied, /metrics answers 404

recommendation engine and ranker

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
beat (single instance)
relay-outbox 10 s
execute-scheduled-transfers 60 s
expire-stale-step-ups 60 s
pay-out-matured-deposits hourly :05
evaluate-feature-drift hourly :20
monitor-structuring-deposits hourly :35
ensure-clickstream-partitions 01:30
materialize-monthly-spending 02:00
segment-customers-weekly Sunday 03:00
purge-expired-idempotency-keys 04:15
purge-processed-outbox-events 04:30
